features: 4-channel multi-directional IR PTRZ camera (4 independently aimed 5MP sensors)
Motorized PTRZ (pan/tilt/rotate/zoom) per channel for install-time aiming
release_notes: Ingest 2026-09-08 (multi-directional gap fill; discontinued). No official DataSheet PDF reachable in Hanwha's PIM and the product page's full spec table is JS-rendered; record built from the official product-details overview. Verified: 4-channel multi-directional IR PTRZ, 5MP per channel (2560x1920; 20MP combined), 4.13-9.4mm 2.3x motorized varifocal per channel, IR 30m, H.265/H.264/MJPEG 30fps@5MP, IP66/IK10/NEMA4X. WDR dB, minimum illumination, microSD capacity, power, operating temperature, dimensions and weight were not machine-readable and are omitted (not fabricated). PTRZ is install-time motorized aiming (not runtime autotracking); no ptz block recorded.

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. Default ONVIF port 80.

blue_iris.notes: Select 'Hanwha' (or 'Samsung' on older Blue Iris versions).
